dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Um... P—Please, get away from me! I—I'm just a normal Melusine, and I'm not tasty at all! Even if you did eat me, it wouldn't fill your tummy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, silly! We're here to save you! We got rid of the monsters already. You're Puca, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Who'd have thought that a Melusine could get caught in seagrass...
